task_family: iid tabular regression (low-cardinality discrete features; synthetic Playground resample)

test_window.evidence: No date/time column in any file. Train id 0..360335, test id 360336..600559 — a contiguous continuation, i.e. a single shuffled table split by row index, not a temporal boundary. All 15 feature columns show the same discrete support in train and test (unit_sales 6/6, total_children 6/6, num_children_at_home 6/6, avg_cars 5/5, units_per_case 36/36, store_sqft 20/20, all five binary store-amenity flags 2/2; store_sales 1044/1035 and gross_weight 384/380 differ only by the count expected from the smaller test n). Stage 1 must still confirm marginal-distribution match per column.

split_policy.scheme: plain KFold (5-fold) on shuffled rows; optionally StratifiedKFold on binned log1p(cost) or on store_sqft (20 levels, a store-identity proxy) to stabilise fold-to-fold variance
split_policy.forbidden: time-based / TimeSeriesSplit (no time axis exists — would be arbitrary); GroupKFold on store_sqft (test shares all 20 store_sqft values with train, so held-out-store generalisation is NOT the evaluated regime and grouping would understate score)
split_policy.notes: 360,336 train rows: 5-fold is cheap and low-variance; no leakage vector identified (no ids repeated across train/test, 0 exactly duplicated feature rows in train).

metric.name: RMSLE
traps: RMSLE is RMSE in log1p space — train on log1p(cost) and predict expm1(pred); do NOT apply an RMSE-style smearing/bias correction on back-transform, the log-space conditional mean is exactly what RMSLE optimises
asymmetric in raw space: under-prediction is penalised more than over-prediction of equal absolute size

target is strictly positive and narrowly bounded (min 50.79, max 149.75, mean 99.61, std 29.94), so the log transform compresses the range only ~3x — gains from log-training are real but modest, and must be verified against raw-space training rather than assumed

target takes only 328 distinct values over 360k rows — heavily discretised; clipping predictions to the observed [50.79, 149.75] range is safe, and rounding-to-observed-grid post-processing is a candidate but must be evaluated INSIDE the metric function so every blend member and blend candidate sees the same post-processing
compute CV as RMSLE on out-of-fold raw-scale predictions, never as mean-of-fold-RMSLEs of log residuals from differently-scaled folds

external_data.rationale: config.yaml special_rules sets external_data_allowed: false, pretrained_models_allowed: false, internet_access_allowed: false. Independently, no whitelist source is joinable: there is no country, region, currency, date, or entity-name column anywhere in the schema, so none of the whitelisted join keys (country x year, country x date, currency x month, country) can be constructed from the official data. The features are already the full covariate set for the household/product/store cost model.

data_level: Treat the 13 low-cardinality columns as CATEGORICAL, not continuous — this is the dossier's primary hypothesis (see matched_task_priors TASK-CAT-ONLY). Cast unit_sales, total_children, num_children_at_home, avg_cars_at_home, units_per_case, store_sqft and the 5 binary amenity flags to a categorical dtype and enable native GBDT categorical handling (LightGBM categorical_feature / CatBoost cat_features).

store_sqft (20 distinct values) is a store-identity key, not a size measurement — the 5 amenity flags (coffee_bar, video_store, salad_bar, prepared_food, florist) are almost certainly store attributes determined by it. Build an explicit store key = tuple(store_sqft, coffee_bar, video_store, salad_bar, prepared_food, florist) and check its cardinality; if it collapses to ~20 groups, use it as a single high-signal categorical rather than 6 columns.
CV-safe target encoding (out-of-fold means/medians of log1p(cost)) for the store key and for units_per_case; smoothing tuned as a hyperparameter.

Pairwise categorical crosses among the household columns (total_children x num_children_at_home, avg_cars x total_children) and store_key x units_per_case — with 360k rows the crosses stay well populated.
Ratio/interaction features on the two genuinely continuous columns: store_sales / unit_sales (implied unit price), gross_weight / units_per_case, store_sales per store_sqft.

Verify whether cost is a near-deterministic function of a feature subset (target has only 328 distinct values) — group by the store key and inspect within-group cost spread before committing to a generic regressor.
model_level: Train on log1p(cost) with L2 objective, so the training loss IS the competition metric; back-transform with expm1.
LightGBM and CatBoost with native categorical handling as the primary lineage; CatBoost's ordered target statistics are a strong fit for the low-cardinality categorical regime.
An XGBoost one-hot / ordinal member for library diversity in the blend (all-categorical data one-hots to a small, dense matrix here).

Blend with NNLS closed-form weights on out-of-fold predictions in log1p space (RMSLE is an RMSE-family metric in that space, so NNLS is exact; Dirichlet weight search carries ~1e-5 approximation error that can exceed the real gain).

TASK-BLEND-DECOR is not matched yet — its trigger is observed at blend time. If the pool ends up dominated by deep low-regularization GBDTs, add one shallow heavily-regularized diverse-library member (e.g. regularized linear model on target-encoded categoricals) as a decorrelator before re-optimizing weights.

prior_match_notes.TASK-CAT-ONLY: Trigger fits with one caveat on presentation: all 15 feature columns are stored as float64, but 13 of 15 are low-cardinality discrete (2 to 36 distinct values; store_sqft 20, units_per_case 36, the rest 2-6). Only store_sales (1044 distinct) and gross_weight (384 distinct) behave as continuous. The float dtype disguises a near-all-categorical problem, which is exactly the failure mode this prior guards against: the prior's own evidence line records that on this competition AIDE's only outright win came from a node that accidentally enabled native categorical handling. Encoding is therefore the central lever here, and enabling it must be a deliberate, early, explicitly-raced lane rather than an accident.
